blocks.text: Performance metrics (model ka kaam naapne ke tareeqe) batate hain ke model kitna achha kaam kar raha hai. Kuch aam metrics:

Error metrics naapte hain ke model ke andaze asal qeematon se kitne alag hain. Grocery ki misal mein agar model mahine ke bill ka andaza 8,000 rupay lagaye aur asal bill 10,000 rupay ho to yeh farq (2,000 rupay) error hai.
Accuracy metrics batate hain ke model ke kitne andaze sahi the. Maslan agar model batata hai ke student pass hoga ya fail, to accuracy naapti hai ke model kitni baar sahi tha.

blocks.prompt: Ek pass/fail model 20 andaze lagata hai aur un mein se 17 sahi hain. Accuracy kya hai?

items: Error metrics asal qeemat se farq naapte hain; accuracy metrics ginte hain ke kitne andaze sahi the.
